mechanism.label: Replicated complete MLP inside TP attention
mechanism.causal_input: Complete current N3 output and residual after the attention reduction and preceding norms.
mechanism.concurrent_unit: The same complete ready-row MLP runs on each rank. Each rank obtains its required complete local output.
mechanism.ownership_change: Every rank retains full physical MLP weights. Attention weights and depth/layer KV retain ordinary TP ownership.
mechanism.added_cost: P-fold aggregate MLP arithmetic and logical weight operands, extra weight capacity, full-width local scratch, loading and graph changes.
mechanism.exactness: Same real-arithmetic function. BF16 shard boundaries can change results. No bitwise or task-quality claim.
mechanism.frontier: At most C ready rows for one physical operator at C1/2/4/8. R4 does not multiply independent current-token work.
mechanism.Fixed_R4: All four passes execute. Remove 96 or 192 MLP reductions structurally.
mechanism.original_adaptive: Retain original q=.5, minR2, maxR4, gate ordering, selected output, and last_exited publication. No future gate oracle.
mechanism.alias_caution: An aliased executor can retain the same physical replicas. Representability alone does not reject an ownership optimum.
mechanism.current_missing_fact: No capacity boundary or low-row incremental latency advantage establishes a recurrence-specific optimum.

local_sources.observation: Native MLP uses merged column projection, SiluAndMul, and a row projection. Four norms and split residuals remain.
RowParallelLinear reduces partial outputs when reduce_results is true and TP exceeds one.
The actual block has four distinct RMSNorms around attention, MLP, and residual operations.
The original hazard accumulates in order. Minimum depth controls whether that current hazard can terminate the token.
The full-local arm runs complete MLPs on every rank. The TP arm slices weights and reduces its output. Both use the same isolated graph timing protocol.
local_sources.native_difference: The component uses separate gate/up linears and F.silu. Native Ouro uses merged projection and SiluAndMul.

local_sources.role: Strong fixed baseline retains native async scheduling and whole-R4 graph replay. Its graph fraction is a local cached-decode denominator, not E2E.
